termination.denominator: all attempted games in a cohort
termination.interpretation: Failure to finish is an unresolved rules or execution issue.

actions.eligibility: complete; raw stalled totals retained separately
actions.interpretation: Does not count bids or acknowledgements as turns.

meaningful.formula: commands excluding continue and committed roll; include setup roll choices
meaningful.interpretation: Includes legal bids/passes and power choices, not human minutes.

auctions.interpretation: Different from action count or issued shares.

prices.formula: paid amounts of auctions with a winner
prices.interpretation: Quantiles describe sales; no independent-sale confidence interval.

spread.interpretation: Not the winning player's score margin.

values.formula: market kind present at action start; valueResolved events per kind
values.denominator: all primary self and mixed attempts
values.eligibility: deduplicate kind within each market exposure
values.interpretation: Exposure is not legal play opportunity; no-effect is engine flag, not causal utility.

founders.formula: action starts active/available; founder events; resolver founderMovement ledger
founders.interpretation: Gross attributed movement, not causal power; Max skipping and Mack cash are outside this movement ledger.

winCredit.interpretation: Conditional on completion and heterogeneous opponents; not optimal strategy.

rounds.eligibility: all completed games; leg timings conditional on reaching that leg
rounds.interpretation: One action per player; final round can be partial.

reveals.eligibility: all completed games; leg timings conditional on reaching that leg
reveals.interpretation: Includes one-die setup; purchased shares reveal two dice together.

legEnds.eligibility: all completed games; leg timings conditional on reaching that leg
legEnds.interpretation: Three companies currently meet the boundary; games can end without finishing leg one.
